subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should the session workspace panel expose existence and metadata for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary, or should it filter/neutralize those entries while preserving containment?
rationale: The central remaining false-Missing fix crosses a Gateway file metadata boundary; automation can identify the risk but should not choose the product/security contract for outside-root session-file entries.

options.title: Preserve Fs-Safe Boundary
options.body: Treat outside-root or fs-safe-rejected entries as hidden, neutral, or non-previewable without raw filesystem metadata exposure, then fix the UI copy/semantics around those entries.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: Allow the panel to show existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned external paths with explicit maintainer approval, tests, and documentation of the boundary.

recommendation.title: Preserve Fs-Safe Boundary
recommendation.body: Treat outside-root or fs-safe-rejected entries as hidden, neutral, or non-previewable without raw filesystem metadata exposure, then fix the UI copy/semantics around those entries.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace file preview and fs-safe containment history makes this the strongest available owner for the boundary decision.
